current_grouping: Subpart J — Auxiliary Power Unit Installations

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart J — Auxiliary Power Unit Installations
versions.text:
(See AMC 25.1189)
(a) Each APU compartment specified in CS 25J1181(a) must have a means to shut-off or otherwise prevent hazardous quantities of flammable fluids, from flowing into, within, or through any designated fire zone, except that shut-off means are not required for:
  (1) Lines, fittings and components forming an integral part of an APU; and
  (2) Oil systems for APU installations in which all external components of the oil system, including the oil tanks, are fireproof.
(b) The closing of any fuel shut-off valve for any APU may not make fuel unavailable to the main engines.
(c) Operation of any shut-off may not interfere with the later emergency operation of other equipment.
(d) Each flammable fluid shut-off means and control must be fireproof or must be located and protected so that any fire in a fire zone will not affect its operation.
(e) No hazardous quantity of flammable fluid may drain into any designated fire zone after shut-off.
(f) There must be means to guard against inadvertent operation of the shut-off means and to make it possible for the crew to reopen the shut-off means in flight after it has been closed.
(g) Each tank to APU shut-off valve must be located so that the operation of the valve will not be affected by the APU mount structural failure.
(h) Each shut-off valve must have a means to relieve excessive pressure accumulation unless a means for pressure relief is otherwise provided in the system.
